title: Ketheric's Warhammer
summary: Versatile +1 martial warhammer that adds 1d4 Psychic damage to hits.

fields.Damage: One hand: 1d8 + 1 Bludgeoning. Two hands: 1d10 + 1 Bludgeoning. Add Strength to damage, +1 to attack rolls and 1d4 Psychic to hits.
fields.Handling: Martial melee weapon with 5 ft reach. Dippable.
fields.Acquisition: Loot or disarm Ketheric Thorm during either fight.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Backbreaker: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack against a Large or smaller target for 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning. A Strength save against weapon-action DC prevents Prone for 2 turns.
fields.Concussive Smash: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Deal weapon damage on a melee hit. A Constitution save prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Use the higher of spell save DC and weapon-action DC +2.
fields.Weakening Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee attack for 1d4 + Strength modifier nonlethal Bludgeoning. A Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Weak Grip for 2 turns. Weak Grip imposes disadvantage on attack rolls and Strength saves. Help removes it.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
